meta.source: Coded from the published QP and mark scheme (1MA1_1F_2506). Derived metadata only — question numbers, marks and skill tags. No exam question text transcribed.
meta.note: First non-AQA paper. Marks per part read from the question paper's own part totals and checked against the printed 80. Three tagging judgements are recorded in coding_notes below rather than left implicit.

coding_notes: q5 (name the type of a 53 degree angle) tagged measuring_lines_and_angles: the taxonomy has no 'classify an angle' node, and this is the nearest genuine skill rather than an invented one.
q8a (complete a kite on a grid from two given sides) tagged symmetry: the task is reflecting the given sides, and there is no quadrilateral-properties node.
q18 (construct a stem and leaf diagram) tagged gathering_and_organising_data: no stem-and-leaf node exists, but organising raw data into a diagram is squarely what that skill covers.
